posts.title: Rebel Fleet Trooper
posts.description: I wanted to see if I could add a Fleet Trooper to my Rebels. Personally, I think it's silly that all Rebel 'Fleet Troopers' would look like the ones seen at the beginning of Star Wars. If you are trying to argue you are on a diplomatic mission, it's not your best move to bring a bunch of rebels in uniform... posts.title: Get to the Fighters!
posts.description: I have added an X-wing pilot to my growing rebellion. He's made with pieces from the Stargrave: Crew box. The uniform isn't actually that close to what you see in the movies, but just painting the suit orange with white straps is pretty much all you need!

posts.title: Another Recruit
posts.description: Another recruit to the rebel cause! The pieces for this one come from the Stargrave Scavengers 2 box, with the head possibly being from the Crew 2 set. I chopped down the gun a bit to look more like Star Wars blaster size.
